BadRequest.description: Bad request, or a query parameter that is not allowed

Conflict.description: Refused by the engine's rules (state, WIP, sprint, approval)

Forbidden.description: Wrong Host, or an Origin header

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or revoked device key

Account.description: A provider account, by reference only.

company_ids.description: The companies whose runs may use it.

config_dir.description: The account's harness config dir, under each runner's config root.

credential_env.description: The harness variable the token goes in.

credential_ref.description:
The token file's name under each runner's credentials dir; absent when the account
logs in through its config dir.

plan_tier.description: Its plan tier as the admin wrote it (`Max 20x`, `Pro`); shown, never enforced.

status_until.description: When a `limited` or `unhealthy` status ends by itself, if known.

AccountLimit.description: A cap on an account's use over a rolling window.

warn_percent.description: The admin is warned once per window at this share of `max`.

drops.description:
Provider drops in the last `drops_window_secs` (`account.drop_window_secs`); enough of
them (`account.drop_threshold`) make the account unhealthy.

recent_drops.description:
Provider drops in the last `recent_drops_window_secs`
(`account.drop_display_window_secs`, a day by default), for display.

signal.description: The harness's latest plan-limit report (Claude's windows), as it sent it.

Actor.description: An agent or a person: who owns an issue, wrote a comment, reviews.

appearance.description: How the client draws its figure (decision #61).

avatar_url.description: Its uploaded image, shown instead of the figure; absent when it has none.

chain_preset_id.description:
The chain preset it uses in place of its own fallbacks (API minor 18); absent when it has
none.

description.description: What the admin wrote about it (API minor 17).

effort.description: Absent: the harness default. Stored and shown; not yet applied by dispatch.

paused_at.description: When the admin paused it (decision #34); absent unless it is paused by the admin.

queued_wakes.description: Wakes waiting for it (API minor 18), e.g. while it is paused.

run_token_cap.description:
Its company's effective `run.token_cap` and `issue.token_cap` (0: none); a project
may set its own.

sandbox.description: Absent: the harness default. Stored and shown; not yet applied by dispatch.

AgentChainBody.description: How an agent gets its chain: a preset, or entries of its own. Exactly one.

entries.description:
Use these fallbacks of its own and no preset (no account pins: pin in a preset); an empty
list clears them.

preset_id.description: Use this preset of the agent's company.

AgentChainOut.description: The agent's effective chain after its own entry.

preset_id.description: The preset the agent has set; absent when it uses its own entries (or the default).

AgentProposal.description: An agent the admin proposes; it is hired only once its approval is approved.

description.description: What it is (API minor 17); like the fields below, applied when the hire is approved.

justification.description: Why the company needs it: shown on the hire approval.

org_role.description: Absent: none (`ceo` and `cto` at most once per company).

palette_id.description: One of `listPalettes`; absent: the company's least used.

reports_to.description: An agent of the company it reports to.

runner_tags.description: Capabilities a runner must offer, e.g. `macos`.

team_id.description:
A team of the company to seat it on (with `team_role`, default `member`); a product
owner or lead seat the team has filled is a 409.

AgentSkill.description: A skill an agent's runs are given (E4.3): its latest version, and what it is attached to.

attached_id.description: The department or project id, or the role.

bytes.description: Its body's size; a run gets as many as fit `skills.budget_bytes`, most specific first.

avg_cost_micros.description: The mean dollars of a priced run over the last 8 weeks; absent when none is priced.

daily_spend.description: Each day of the current month so far.

heatmap.description: Runs started in the last 28 days: 7 rows, Monday first, of 6 four-hour slots (00, 04 … 20 UTC).

AgentUpdate.description:
What to change about an agent; absent fields stay, `null` clears `effort`, `sandbox` and
`reports_to`. At least one field is needed.

guidelines.description: At most 50, each 1-500 characters; replaces the list.

reports_to.description: An agent of the company that does not report to this one; `null`: nobody.

runner_tags.description: At most 20 tags, each 1-64 characters without spaces.

reply.description: Goes back to the agent, as with any approval.

rule.description:
The allowlist entry: `<tool>` or `<tool>:<command prefix>`. Absent: the escalated call's
tool and its command's first two words (`Bash:cargo add`), or the tool alone.

ApiVersion.description: The contract a server speaks: `/api/<major>` and its additions so far.

minor.description: Bumped on every additive change within the major.

Appearance.description: An agent's figure: which version the client draws, in which palette (`listPalettes`).

AppearanceChange.description: A new look: a palette, and a figure version when it changes.

anyOf.description: From when a new price applies.

decided_at.description: When it was approved, rejected or expired; absent while pending.

payload.description: What is asked, by kind (the sprint's issues, the command, the overrun, …).

redactions.description: Secrets redacted from its content before it was stored (text artifacts only).

unscanned.description: Stored as it is, never scanned for secrets (not text: images, PDF, zip).

AuditPage.description:
A page of the audit log, newest first. `next_before` continues with older rows, absent on
the last page.

hard_stop.description: Runs stop at the cap (the default), or it only warns.

scope.description: The company itself, or one of its departments, projects, agents, sprints or issues.

token_cap.description: Tokens, 0 or more; 0 with a `usd_cap_micros` is a dollars-only budget.

usd_cap_micros.description:
Millionths of a dollar, 0 or more, enforced beside the tokens when set (API minor 18);
absent clears it. The dollars counted are the priced ones.

BudgetStanding.description: A budget and its spend in the current period.

raised.description: Tokens added for the period by approved overruns.

raised_usd_micros.description: Dollars added for the period by approved overruns, in millionths (API minor 18).

usd_cap_micros.description:
Millionths of a dollar beside the tokens, when set; with `token_cap` 0, dollars only
(API minor 18).

usd_spent_micros.description: Priced dollars spent in the period, in millionths (API minor 18).

left.description: Points left at the end of the day.

scope.description: Points in scope that day (API minor 19); absent on a sprint's burndown.

CfdDay.description: One day of a cumulative flow diagram.

counts.description: Issues in each state at the day's end, every state present (zero when empty).

ChainEntryBody.description: One entry of a chain, tried in order.

account_id.description: Pin the entry to one account of the company's pool; absent: any.

ChainPresetBody.description: A preset to store; `PUT` replaces all of it.

entries.description: At most 20; an account pin must be in the company's pool.

is_default.description: Make it the company's default chain (the old default stops being it).
The chain agents with no chain of their own use.

Changed.description: The agents a company-wide pause or resume changed.

carry_to.description: A planned sprint to carry the unfinished issues to; else they go back to the backlog.

run_id.description: The run it was written from, for an agent's comment.

account_ids.description: The pool accounts its runs may use (E15.1).

color.description: Its colour, `#rrggbb` (API minor 17); absent when unset, as every optional field here.

description.description: What it does, for its agents (empty when unset).

logo_url.description: Its uploaded logo (`getCompanyLogo`); absent when it has none.

work_days.description: Working days as a bitmask: bit 0 Monday … bit 6 Sunday (31 = Monday to Friday).

CompanyAccountUsage.description: What a company used of one account.

CompanyChange.description: What to change; absent fields stay, `null` clears an optional one.

anyOf.description: The admin's own company, or a client's (E15.14).

CompanyUsage.description: What one company used of one account, all time.

CostReport.description:
Runs that used tokens, and what they cost. Dollars are the priced runs' only: an unpriced
run is counted, with its tokens, never as $0.

Criterion.description: One acceptance criterion of an issue.

cost_usd_micros.description: Priced dollars, in millionths; unpriced spend is in `tokens` only.

raise_tokens.description:
A `budget_overrun` is approved with this many more tokens for the period (millionths of
a dollar when the approval's payload `unit` is `usd_micros`).

reply.description: Goes back to the agent that asked, and wakes it.

head_agent_id.description: The agent that heads it; absent when it has none.

DepartmentUpdate.description: What to change about a department; absent fields stay, `null` clears the head.

anyOf.description: Who may deploy to an environment.

Device.description: A device's key, without the key.

last_used_at.description: Marked at most once a minute.

DodRule.description: One definition-of-done rule and whether it is on (API minor 18).

anyOf.description: How hard an agent thinks (API minor 17).

url.description: Empty when it has none; never holding credentials.

key.description: `KEY-E3`: its project's key and its number there, never reused.

epic_id.description: Absent takes it out of its epic.

EpicPatch.description:
An epic's fields to change (API minor 18); absent fields keep their value, `null` clears an
optional one.

requirement_id.description: One of the project company's requirements.

ErrorBody.description: A JSON error: a stable `code` and a message for people.

error_id.description:
`err_` and a ULID, unique to this answer: logged with it (and, for a refused write,
audited as `api.refused`), for the app's "Copy error".

points.description: Story points; absent clears the estimate.

Event.description: One entry of the event stream. `seq` only grows: it is the replay cursor.

EventActor.description: Who acted, on an audited change.

EventPayload.description: What happened. New types may be added: a client skips an event it cannot decode.

EventPayloadAudit.description:
An audited change: `action` is dotted (`issue.in_review`, `run.failed`,
`approval.approved`, …) and names the `entity` it happened to.

EventPayloadTranscript.description: A chunk of a run's transcript.

EventPayloadWake.description: A wake queued for an agent.

Fallback.description: One entry of the chain, tried in order after the agent's own harness and model.

anyOf.description:
What an agent's figure shows, first match wins:

| state | when |
|---|---|
| `sleepy` | the agent is paused |
| `rest` | it waits on its hire approval, or is terminated |
| `listening` | it has an open question to the admin, or an approval it asked for is pending |
| `working` | its run is running and has produced output |
| `thinking` | its run is running, no output yet |
| `loading` | its run is queued or claimed by a runner, not yet started |
| `confused` | its last run failed, timed out, lost its runner or stalled |
| `success` | its last run succeeded in the last five minutes |
| `idle` | otherwise |

checkout_run_id.description: The run holding the issue, while one does.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria, in order (API minor 18).

priority.description: Bumped by the admin (`bumpIssue`): its wakes go first.

priority_level.description:
`none` … `urgent` (API minor 18); `priority` is true from `high` up. Absent from a
server below 18.

rank.description: Backlog order within the project: lower first.

repo_implicit.description:
True when the issue has no explicit repo and its project has several, so it works in the
primary one (API minor 20). Set on a single-issue read; omitted when false.

requirement_id.description: The requirement it serves (E15.10), Quest's requirement tag.

IssueDiff.description: An issue's worktrees as last measured by a run's runner.

run_id.description: The run that measured them; absent before any did.

age_secs.description: Created → done, or → now while open.

done_at.description: Last done, while it is done.

IssuePatch.description: The fields of an issue the admin edits (API minor 18); absent fields keep their value.

IssuePr.description: An issue's pull request on one of its repos.

checks_note.description: What `checks` is made of when the forge token cannot read every check.

push_held.description:
Why the runner's push of its branch was refused for good; it opens once the branch is
on the forge.

unpushed_at.description: When opening it found its head branch not pushed (it waits for a later run's push).

repos.description: The repos it touches, in the project's order.

IssuedDevice.description: A new device and its key: the only time the key is ever shown.

body_truncated.description: The body was cut to 16 KiB in a list.

proposed_by_agent_id.description: The agent that proposed it; absent for an entry the admin added.

rationale.description: The proposer's one-line reason for it.

reason.description: Why it was accepted or rejected.

status.description: `retired`: kept for history, never given to a run.

superseded_by.description: The entry that replaced this one.

target.description: What accepting a proposal applies its body to: `spec` or `profile.<field>`.

updated_at.description: Its last audited change (`created_at` when none).

KnowledgeDecision.description: A human's decision on a proposal.

Label.description: A label of a project, put on its issues.

name.description: One line, 1–50 characters, unique in the project.

LastRepair.description:
An automatic repair (E15.8): its action (`rewake`, `escalate`, …, or `escalate_to_admin`
past the issue's repair budget) and when.

LatestEvent.description: The newest event's seq a client would be shown: the catch-up target.

used.description: Used in the window ending now.

Me.description: The calling device and what it may see.

companies.description:
The companies this key may see: every one, or only the acting one when
`X-Citadel-Company` is sent.

latest_seq.description: The newest event's seq it would be shown (as `GET /api/v1/events/latest`).

user.description: The user it acts as: the one admin.

capacity.description: Points it takes on per sprint; absent when not set.

MessageDelivery.description:
Where a message to a run went: to the run (`message_id`; its harness gets it at its next
turn, shown in the transcript as a `user_message` chunk with that id), or, the run not live,
a comment on its issue waking the run's agent (`comment_id`). A message the run ends before
taking becomes such a comment too.

ModelTier.description:
The (harness, model) an agent's tasks of `tier` start on. Its own harness and model are
its standard tier, so only `small` and `large` are set here.

anchor_issue_id.description: The issue to go before or after.

Named.description: A device or a user: who, by id and name.

credential_env.description: Default: the harness's first auth variable, e.g. `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.

credential_ref.description: A file name under each runner's credentials dir; never the token itself.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key on the same issue posts (and wakes) once.

wake_agent_id.description:
The agent to wake (one of the issue's company). Absent: the first agent the body
mentions (`@agent:<id>`, or `@<name>`, any case), else the agent working a `todo` or
`in_progress` issue (its owner), else its next actor. An open question on the issue is
answered by the comment and wakes its asker either way.

NewCompany.description:
A new company. The profile fields (API minor 17) are optional; see `Company` for their
shapes. A field out of shape is a 400.

assignee_agent_id.description: An agent to hand it to at once, which wakes it.

state.description: `backlog` or `todo`; `backlog` when absent, `todo` with an assignee.

warn_percent.description: Default: the account's `account.warn_percent` setting (80 unless set).

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key on the same run is taken once.

apply_from.description:
`now` (the default): from the next cost event on. `past`: also price the metered cost
events of this harness and model that have no dollars yet (API minor 18).

input_usd_per_mtok.description: Dollars per million tokens, 0 or more (as `citadel-server price set`).

key.description:
Issue-number prefix, unique in the company: 1–10 capital letters and digits, starting
with a letter (`CIT` for `CIT-12`).

sprint_approval.description: Who approves a sprint commit; absent: the owner.

team_id.description: The team that owns it, one of the company's.

team_ids.description: Every team, the owner first (API minor 18); wins over `team_id`.

NewRequest.description: A request to the company, for its CEO to route.

project_id.description: The company's project it is for (API minor 18): a hint, named in the CEO's wake.

tags.description: Capabilities it offers, e.g. `macos`, `xcode`; it may send its own when it connects.

NewSkillVersion.description: A new version of a skill.

attach_role.description: The role (matched exactly against an agent's role).

NextActor.description: Who moves an issue next: an agent, a person, or a timer at `at`.

seq.description: The audit sequence of the `notifications.test` event just emitted.

matrix.description: Every event and channel, with its choice or its default.

NotificationsUpdate.description: What to change; absent fields stay.

wake_status.description: `pending`, or `coalesced` into the wake already waiting.

OrgChart.description: A company's agents (with `reports_to`, the chart's edges) and its departments and teams.

Page_Artifact.description: A page of a list. `next_after` is the cursor of the next page, absent on the last.

Page_Event.description: A page of a list. `next_after` is the cursor of the next page, absent on the last.

Page_Run.description: A page of a list. `next_after` is the cursor of the next page, absent on the last.

Page_TranscriptChunk.description: A page of a list. `next_after` is the cursor of the next page, absent on the last.

code.description: The code the admin was shown, in any case.

name.description: What to call the new device.

code.description: Six characters, letters and digits; shown to the user once.

Palette.description: A palette the client colours a figure with.

plan_tier.description: 1–64 characters, e.g. `Max 20x`; absent or empty clears it.

PlanDiff.description: The plan now against its approved version: scope added or removed since.

PlanTask.description: A task as a plan version holds it.

anyOf.description:
Where an issue's pull request is: `requested` (opened once the run that asked ends),
`open`, `merging` (approved; the poller merges it), `merged`, `closed` (not merged).

Price.description:
A harness and model's price, US dollars per million tokens; each set is a new version, and
earlier spend keeps the version that priced it.

PriceVersion.description: One version of a price, from when it took effect.

priority.description:
`true` (the default): to the top of its backlog, its wakes dispatched first; `false`
clears the flag and leaves its place.

anyOf.description: How much an issue matters (API minor 18).

ProbeBody.description: A repo to look at before it is added.

forge.description:
Absent: git alone is asked. With it, the forge says whether the token may push, and git
uses the token for a private repo.

url.description: An https, http or ssh URL, or an absolute path.

Probed.description: What a probe found; nothing was saved.

can_push.description: Absent when unknown: no forge given, or the forge could not say.

note.description: Why something is unknown, in a line.

stack.description: Detected from a shallow clone's files, "Rust · Node"; empty when none was recognised.

Profile.description: A project's profile. Every field may be empty.

definition_of_done.description: Rules an issue meets before it is done.

definition_of_done_rules.description:
`definition_of_done` with each rule's switch (API minor 18): the rules are the source, and
`definition_of_done` is the text of those that are on. A patch of `definition_of_done`
alone replaces the rules, all on.

network_hosts.description: Hosts runs may reach when `network` is not off (API minor 18).

ProfileChange.description: One step of a profile's history.

action.description:
`project.profile_set` (a change), or `knowledge.proposed`, `knowledge.accepted` or
`knowledge.rejected` (an agent's proposal of one).

details.description:
A change: `fields` changed and their new `values` (absent on changes made before values
were recorded), `knowledge_entry` when a proposal made it. A proposal step: its
`profile_field`, `title`, `rationale` or decision `reason`.

seq.description: Its audit sequence number: the cursor of the next page.

ProfilePatch.description:
Fields to change; absent ones stay. The approval policy and permission mode live on
the project and are changed through the same call.

definition_of_done.description: Rules an issue meets before it is done.

definition_of_done_rules.description:
`definition_of_done` with each rule's switch (API minor 18): the rules are the source, and
`definition_of_done` is the text of those that are on. A patch of `definition_of_done`
alone replaces the rules, all on.

network_hosts.description: Hosts runs may reach when `network` is not off (API minor 18).

ProfilePreview.description: What a run on the project is told about it.

budget_bytes.description: The profile's budget (`profile.budget_bytes`); the profile text is fitted to it.

dropped.description: Sections the budget leaves out of the text (named at its end).

text.description:
The project's profile and accepted knowledge exactly as a run's instructions carry them
(a run's skills come first there, and are per agent); empty when it has neither.

ProfileProposal.description: An agent's pending proposal of a new value for one field.

body.description: The new value: JSON, or plain text for a text field.

id.description: The knowledge entry; decided with `decideProfileProposal` (a person only, #48).

rationale.description: Why the agent proposes it, in one line, when it said.

icon.description: A symbol or emoji (API minor 18); absent when unset, as every field below.

runner_tags.description:
Runtime: the tags a runner needs for its runs, the cap on parallel runs, the run timeout
in seconds and how many days worktrees are kept. Stored and shown; not yet applied by
dispatch.

team_ids.description: Every team on it, the owner first; `team_id` is the first.

issues.description: Each done issue, by when it was done.

throughput.description: Top-level issues done in the window.

allow.description:
What goes ahead without asking: a tool name (`Edit`), or `<tool>:<command prefix>`
(`Bash:npm run`), which never matches a command with shell operators. A path outside
the worktree always asks.

mode.description:
`ask`: everything outside the allowlist asks; `accept_edits`: file edits inside the
run's worktree go ahead too; `sandboxed`: the harness acts without asking, only on a
sandboxed runner.

sandboxed.description: Runs need a sandboxed runner; implied by the `sandboxed` mode.

dropped.description: Sections the budget leaves out of a run's instructions (named there).

injected_bytes.description:
Bytes of the profile a run is given in its instructions, of `budget_bytes` (the
`profile.budget_bytes` setting).

updated_at.description: Absent while the profile was never changed.

icon.description: A symbol or emoji; `null` clears it.

mode.description: Scrum to kanban only with no planned or active sprint.

runner_tags.description: Runtime (API minor 18), stored and shown: the tags a runner needs, replacing the list.

team_id.description: The owning team, one of the company's; `null` clears it, absent keeps it.

team_ids.description: Every team, the owner first (API minor 18); wins over `team_id`.

ProposedAgent.description: A proposed agent and the approval that hires it.

sandbox.description: A development build's token, for the sandbox gateway.

token.description: The device token, hex, as the app got it from APNs.

Question.description: An agent's question for the admin: a card while open, a receipt once answered.

issue_id.description: The asker's issue, where the answer goes.

QuietHours.description:
Quiet hours: minutes from midnight (0-1439); the window wraps past midnight when `start` is
after `end`.

breakthrough.description: What still gets through: `stalled` (stalled production work) or `nothing`.

agent_id.description:
An active member of the issue's project's team (any active agent of its company when the
project has no team).

RegisteredRunner.description: A registered runner and its key: shown only now, never stored (only its hash is).

in_use_by.description:
The keys of the issues working it now (API minor 18): in progress or in review, and
approved for it, or, with none approved, on the primary repo.

position.description: Its place in the project's order: the order agents see repos and PRs merge in.

stack.description: What it is built with, "Rust · Node" (API minor 18); empty when unknown.

RepoBody.description: A repo to add, or a repo's new values.

stack.description: Absent: a repo keeps its stack, a new one has none.

RepoDiff.description: One repo's worktree against its base.

repo.description: The repo's name in its project; empty for an issue's only repo.

api_url.description: Absent (when setting): the host's public API.

token_file.description: The server-side file holding the API token (never the token).

RepoRequest.description: An agent's request for another repo, waiting for its team lead (or the admin).

anyOf.description: How urgent a request is; `normal` is the `medium` level, `urgent` bumps its wakes.

intake_issue_id.description: The intake request; its comments are the requirement's thread.

owner_agent_id.description: Who answers in the thread: the CEO, then the product owner it was handed to.

paused_at.description: When the admin paused it (API minor 18); absent unless it is paused.

plan_version.description: The approved plan's version; 0 before the first approval.

project_id.description: The project it was filed for (API minor 18).

reason.description: Why, for the audit and the thread's readers.

burndown.description:
Points left at the end of each day since the plan's approval (or the requirement's
creation).

diff.description: Absent before the plan's first approval.

eta.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD` the rest is done at the pace so far; absent before anything is done or
before three days of data.

other.description: Its issues outside the plan: the intake request, the kickoff.

percent_done.description: By points, rounded; leaf product tasks only (documentation tasks are left out).

Retried.description: The wake that will start a retry.

runner_id.description: The runner it is pinned to.

reason.description: Why it was accepted or rejected.

runner_id.description: The runner to run it on; it must hold every one of the agent's runner tags.

RoleBody.description: A role to store; `PUT` replaces all of it.

RoleModel.description:
The model agents of `role` (their role, any case) run on in this project when they have
none of their own, and for their small and large tiers when they have none (E15.5).

budget_tokens.description: Its token budget per month, when the role has a default.

harness.description: What a new agent of the role starts on; absent: the client's choice.

icon.description: A glyph name the client draws; free text.

account_id.description: The provider account it works as (E15.1).

context_tokens.description: Its first turn's input tokens, cache included: the context it started with (E15.5).

diff_files.description: Files its worktree differs from the base in, as last measured (E15.7).

diff_repos.description:
Each repo's diff against its base, as last measured (runner protocol 1.18), in the
issue's repo order; empty before any measure.

fallback_reason.description: Why it is not on its agent's first (harness, model): every reason, in order (E15.3).

last_progress_at.description:
When its runner last saw it progress (E15.7): a tool call, a file change, a new message
or more tokens. With the project's `run.stall_after_secs`, how close it is to stalling.

tier.description: The tier its task was routed to (E15.5); absent on runs from before.

transcript_gone_reason.description: Why its transcript is gone, when it is: `pruned` (`transcript.retention_secs`).

woken_at.description:
Stage timings (E15.6): when its wake was due, its harness first reported and its model

info.description: The Citadel client API, for the Ainkrad app. Every request carries a device key as `Authorization: Bearer` (never in the URL) and the server's own `Host`, and no `Origin`. A client working in one company sends its id as `X-Citadel-Company`: every route then answers 404 for another company's data, and lists that span companies keep to it. Times are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds. Versioning: within /api/v1, enum values, union variants, optional fields and operations may be added; a client must keep an unknown enum value (every enum is open) and skip an event or union variant it cannot decode. Anything removed or renamed is a new /api/v2. `info.version` is `1.<minor>.0`; the minor (`GET /api/v1/me`, `versions.api.minor`) is bumped on every addition.
